TIMEFRAME SWEEP for PIKK. Every parameter is PINNED to a single value (the hand-picked stack: regime+trail+volume ON; trend/HTF/overbought/breakeven/ATR-stop OFF; catstop 2.0), so calibration evaluates exactly ONE config. Purpose: run the SAME fixed config across different timeframes to compare. The timeframe is the -interval flag, not a grid key, so re-run this one file per interval. Values mirror pikk.DefaultParams() as of 2026-06-24. Runs (adjust windows per timeframe; lookback is 205 bars):
  Hour1:    go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker PIKK -strategy reversion -interval Hour1    -calibrate data/params/pikk/reversion_tf_sweep.json -out ./reports/PIKK/tf/Hour1    -months 48 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 10
  Hour4:    go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker PIKK -strategy reversion -interval Hour4    -calibrate data/params/pikk/reversion_tf_sweep.json -out ./reports/PIKK/tf/Hour4    -months 48 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 10
  Day1:     go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker PIKK -strategy reversion -interval Day1     -calibrate data/params/pikk/reversion_tf_sweep.json -out ./reports/PIKK/tf/Day1     -months 96 -train-months 24 -test-months 12 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 5
  Minutes30:go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker PIKK -strategy reversion -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/pikk/reversion_tf_sweep.json -out ./reports/PIKK/tf/Minutes30 -months 12 -train-months 3 -test-months 1 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 10
NOTE: sub-hour and hour history depth is API-limited; if a fold errors with 'train window has 0 candles', narrow -months/-train-months for that interval. Day1 needs a wide window because 205-bar lookback ~= 10 trading months.
